detail: Decisions: Chose sentinel-file + git-log-HEAD over transcript-grep — immune to transcript text noise and same-turn flush latency. Rejected anchored transcript matching and file mtime.; Wired sentinel into the three explicit recording tool handlers, not into engine methods — preserves gate semantics so internal posts don't reset.; Used node -e for JSON parsing in the hook — node is already a hard dep. Rejected jq (new dependency).; Token-aware trigger: argv[0]=='git' && argv[1]=='commit' after stripping pipes — fixes substring false-positives.
summary: Fixed pre-commit hook false-block (#11, #13). Sentinel file replaces transcript-grep; node JSON parse replaces bash regex; argv-tokenized trigger. Plugin 1.9.0→1.9.1.
